labels.name: get_anthid_overview
labels.description: Return the positioning overview for Anthid: what the platform does, what it replaces, who it is for, and where to go for implementation detail. Use this to answer "what is Anthid" before reaching for a search.

labels.name: list_anthid_pages
labels.description: List every public page on anthid.com with its title, description, and URL. Use this to find the right page to cite or to fetch.

labels.name: search_anthid_api
labels.description: Search the Anthid REST API reference and return matching endpoints with their method, path, and summary. Use this to find which endpoint does something — "submit an order", "list positions", "set a risk control". Follow a match with describe_anthid_endpoint to get its parameters and examples.

labels.name: describe_anthid_endpoint
labels.description: Return the full reference for one endpoint: the authentication it accepts, every parameter with its type and example, the request body schema and example, and the response examples. Read this before writing a request rather than inferring the shape. Accepts a path ("/v1/orders"), a signature ("POST

labels.name: get_anthid_api_schema
labels.description: Return one named schema from the API reference with its references expanded — for example "SubmitIntentParams" or "OrdersResponse". Use this when an endpoint description names a schema you need in full.

labels.name: list_anthid_endpoints
labels.description: List every documented endpoint grouped by service, with its method, path, and summary. Use this to see the shape of the API before searching it.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_anthid_site, list_anthid_pages, describe_anthid_endpoint · Public sink: search_anthid_api, describe_anthid_endpoint.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_anthid_site, list_anthid_pages, describe_anthid_endpoint · Public sink: search_anthid_api, describe_anthid_endpoint

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
